Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary payment bridge (Net-105)

Hi Kimberly,

Following up from our finance sync — Catalyst Health runs on a calendar that sometimes misaligns with vendor payment cycles when we close new contracts near quarter cutoffs. We have a tight cash conversion profile this quarter and would like to request a temporary Net-105 payment cadence for the first 90 days of the contract for DEAL-8392 (pilot + onboarding).

Key ask: Net-105 for three billing cycles, with standard Redwood invoices (no change to tax or billing address). We expect to move to standard Net-30 after the pilot period.

Why: our AR team has a scheduled disbursement window that will only process vendor invoices once every ~35 days for a short, transitional period. Approving Net-105 would let us start the integration and pay on a predictable timeline for us.

Impact: they are committed to a $210k ARR pilot (invoice cadence reflected in attached schedule).

Attachments: Catalyst_Invoice_Schedule.xlsx (stub)

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through.

Thanks,
Emma Sherman

Questions for Deal Desk / Finance / Legal:
- Are there concerns with Net-105 specifically (billing system, tax, collections)?
- What safeguards do we want (e.g. one-time credit hold, payment milestone, discount limit)?

Finance note: if we push Net terms out, we increase DSO and small timing risk on cash; but this is a strategically important pilot account in our healthcare push.

Requested next steps: 
1) Finance/deal desk to recommend conditional approval terms (if any)
2) Exec signoff if terms deviate from standard policy
3) Legal to confirm documentation approach

Thanks for flagging, Kim — reviewed Catalyst's schedule. A couple of operational points and a recommended path: 

Operational notes:
- Billing: our system supports custom payment cadence per contract, so implementation is straightforward.
- Collections: pushing DSO by an extra ~75 days for the first three invoices increases exposure; recommend a conditional approval.

Recommended conditional approval (finance):
1) Approve Net-105 for first three invoices only (90-day window). After that revert to Net-30.
2) Require a 10% pre-payment or a small usage holdback (e.g., withhold 1/3rd of first invoice until first remittance) OR include a one-time 2% invoice processing fee to cover extended terms — pick one.
3) No additional discount beyond existing commercial terms; if they request deeper discounts, escalate.
4) Finance to record updated payment cadence and set an automated escalation to Collections if any invoice goes >15 days past their stated remittance date.

I attached a quick calc showing cash impact under both pre-pay and fee options.

Attachment: rishi_financial_calc.xlsx (stub)

If we want to proceed, we need executive signoff on the conditional terms and Legal to confirm whether we need a contract amendment or internal acceptance note on file.

- Rishi
Head of Deal Economics
Redwood Inference

Kim / team — I reviewed Rishi's recommendation and Catalyst's profile. I'm comfortable granting a time-limited exception with the following guardrails: 

Executive decision:
- Approve Net-105 for the first three invoices (90 days) for DEAL-8392, conditional on Finance selecting one of the mitigations Rishi proposed (10% pre-pay OR 2% processing fee).
- No additional commercial discounts tied to the extended terms; any discount asks go back to commercial leadership.
- Legal to capture the cadence in a two-line amendment or an internal billing memo that references DEAL-8392; no full contract redline required for this temporary pilot.
- Collections trigger: automated escalation if payment is >15 days past the promised remittance date.
- Log this as a one-off exception and include reasoning in the deal record (region: US, strategic healthcare pilot).
